member.name: SubscribePress
member.summary: Subscribes a handler to the single left presses on a text area, ahead of the editor's own press handler.
member.param: The text area whose presses are delivered.
The handler that receives the press position in the text area's coordinate space and the modifier keys the press holds, and returns whether it takes the press, which then counts as handled.
Reads the held modifier keys in place of the input, or to read them from the input.
member.returns: A subscription that removes the handler when it is disposed.
